description: This file implements the GstWrapper class and related factory functions for managing GStreamer objects, including methods for creating and setting GStreamer structures and caps, with logging and thread safety features.

classes.name: GstWrapper
classes.description: A class providing wrapper methods for GStreamer operations such as creating structures and caps.

classes.name: IGstWrapperFactory
classes.description: An interface for the factory that creates GstWrapper instances.

classes.name: IGstWrapper
classes.description: An interface for the GstWrapper class.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton factory instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getGstWrapper
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton GstWrapper instance, creating it if necessary, with thread safety.

methods.name: gstCapsSetSimple
methods.description: Sets simple caps on a GstCaps object using variable arguments.

methods.name: gstStructureNew
methods.description: Creates a new GstStructure with a given name and first field, using variable arguments.

methods.name: gstStructureSet
methods.description: Sets fields on a GstStructure object using variable arguments.
